observations: Dozens of small oval face-shapes with dot eyes and open mouths ring the olive-gold border and scatter into the mid-ground, each rendered in white outline.
A dense central mass of horizontal color bands—yellow, red, blue, purple, green—is overlaid with black line-work forming larger open-mouthed figures, one bearing crossed-X eyes in the lower left.
White spiky lines radiate upward from two large figures near the top center, while loose scribbled marks in pink and red weave across the middle as a separate layer.
reading: Small oval faces patrol every edge while larger, louder figures crowd the center, mouths wide and eyes exaggerated. Horizontal banding holds the composition in loose rows, but the spiky white lines above and the scribbled pink loops below pull against that order. The mood reads as noise—collective and unresolved, somewhere between festivity and alarm.
